title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
text: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi benefit: Rs 6,000 per year income support, paid in 3 instalments of Rs 2,000 to the bank account

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
text: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi eligibility: Landholding farmer family; Owns cultivable land in their name (tenant farmers are not covered)

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
text: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi document: Documents: Aadhaar card, Land ownership records, Bank account linked with Aadhaar

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
text: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) benefit: Crop insurance at low premium (2% kharif, 1.5% rabi, 5% commercial/horticulture crops)

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
text: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) eligibility: Farmer (owner, tenant or sharecropper) growing notified crops in a notified area

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
text: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) document: Documents: Aadhaar card, Land records or tenancy/sowing certificate, Bank passbook, Sowing declaration

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
text: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) benefit: Short-term crop and allied-activity (dairy, fisheries) credit at concessional interest with interest subvention

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
text: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) eligibility: Farmer, tenant farmer, or engaged in animal husbandry/fisheries; Age 18 or above

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
text: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) document: Documents: Identity proof, Address proof, Land records or tenancy proof, Passport-size photo

title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS)
text: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS) benefit: Rs 12,000 per year (first 3 years of graduation) and Rs 20,000 per year for postgraduation

title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS)
text: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS) eligibility: Regular college student; Family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh per year; Above 80th percentile in Class 12 of their board

title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS)
text: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS) document: Documents: Class 12 marksheet, Income certificate, College admission proof, Bank account details

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship
text: AICTE Pragati Scholarship benefit: Rs 50,000 per year for girl students in AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma courses

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship
text: AICTE Pragati Scholarship eligibility: Student in an AICTE-approved technical course; Girl student; Family income up to Rs 8 lakh per year

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship
text: AICTE Pragati Scholarship document: Documents: Income certificate, Admission letter, Class 10/12 marksheets, Bank account details

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
text: AICTE Saksham Scholarship benefit: Rs 50,000 per year for specially-abled students in AICTE-approved technical courses

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
text: AICTE Saksham Scholarship eligibility: Student in an AICTE-approved technical course; Disability of 40% or more; Family income up to Rs 8 lakh per year

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
text: AICTE Saksham Scholarship document: Documents: Disability certificate, Income certificate, Admission letter, Bank account details

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
text: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) benefit: 15-35% subsidy on bank loan for a new micro-enterprise (projects up to Rs 50 lakh manufacturing / Rs 20 lakh service)

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
text: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) eligibility: Setting up a new micro-enterprise; Age 18 or above

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
text: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) document: Documents: Project report, Identity and address proof, Education certificate (VIII pass for larger projects), Caste/special-category certificate if applicable

title: Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGTMSE)
text: Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGTMSE) benefit: Collateral-free bank loans for micro and small enterprises, guaranteed by CGTMSE

title: Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGTMSE)
text: Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGTMSE) eligibility: New or existing micro/small enterprise

title: Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGTMSE)
text: Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGTMSE) document: Documents: Udyam registration, Business plan / loan application, KYC documents
